question: What attainment makes one dear to the yoginis?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation together form a great accomplishment.
Such great accomplishment can arise for a practitioner.
This accomplishment establishes favor with the yoginis.
inference: One who attains the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginis.
plain_english: He may become dear to the yoginis through the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation.
